pattern_category.description: Best practices for AutoCAD COM connection management

pattern.name: com_initialization
pattern.description: Proper COM initialization with error handling
pattern.code_example:
import pythoncom import win32com.client from typing import Optional
class AutoCADConnectionManager: def __init__(self): self.acad_app = None self.acad_doc = None self.model_space = None self.connected = False
def connect(self) -> bool: """Establish AutoCAD connection with proper COM initialization.""" try: # Initialize COM for the current thread pythoncom.CoInitialize()
# Connect to running AutoCAD instance or start new one try: self.acad_app = win32com.client.GetActiveObject("AutoCAD.Application") print("Connected to running AutoCAD instance") except: self.acad_app = win32com.client.Dispatch("AutoCAD.Application") self.acad_app.Visible = True print("Started new AutoCAD instance")
# Get active document and model space self.acad_doc = self.acad_app.ActiveDocument self.model_space = self.acad_doc.ModelSpace self.connected = True
return True
except Exception as e: print(f"Failed to connect to AutoCAD: {e}") return False
def disconnect(self): """Clean up COM objects and disconnect.""" try: if self.acad_app: # Release COM objects in reverse order self.model_space = None self.acad_doc = None self.acad_app = None
# Uninitialize COM pythoncom.CoUninitialize() self.connected = False
except Exception as e: print(f"Error during disconnect: {e}")

best_practices.practice: Always call pythoncom.CoInitialize() before COM operations
Use try/catch blocks for connection failures
Implement proper cleanup in disconnect method
Handle both existing and new AutoCAD instances

pattern.name: variant_array_conversion
pattern.description: Convert Python coordinates to AutoCAD VARIANT arrays
pattern.code_example:
import win32com.client import pythoncom
def convert_to_variant_array(coordinates: tuple) -> Any: """Convert Python coordinates to AutoCAD VARIANT array format.
Args: coordinates: Tuple of (x, y, z) coordinates
Returns: win32com.client.VARIANT array compatible with AutoCAD """ try: # Ensure we have 3D coordinates coords = [ float(coordinates[0]), float(coordinates[1]), float(coordinates[2]) if len(coordinates) > 2 else 0.0 ]
# Create VARIANT array using the working format variant_array = win32com.client.VARIANT( pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, coords )
return variant_array
except Exception as e: raise ValueError(f"Failed to convert coordinates {coordinates}: {e}")
def create_circle(center: tuple, radius: float): """Create a circle with proper parameter marshalling.""" try: # Validate inputs if radius <= 0: raise ValueError(f"Invalid radius: {radius}")
# Convert center to VARIANT array center_variant = convert_to_variant_array(center)
# Create the circle circle = model_space.AddCircle(center_variant, radius)
return circle
except Exception as e: raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to create circle: {e}")

best_practices.practice: Always validate input parameters before conversion
Use pythoncom.VT_R8 for double-precision coordinates
Handle both 2D and 3D coordinate inputs
Provide detailed error messages for conversion failures
